races.name: Coral Chesterfield Cup Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Liberty Lane
runners_data.note: Won last time on Soft ground over 10f but has Good-going form too; lone front-runner with a clear tactical advantage here, though her highest OR (109) and 138lbs means she sets the race up for others — style fit is high but winning chance tempered by weight and being potentially vulnerable late.

runners_data.name: Bolster
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who has been running on Soft almost exclusively in recent starts; 53 days off the track and five straight defeats including a run of 9ths make him hard to trust, even if the Good ground is theoretically fine.

runners_data.name: Torito
runners_data.note: Gosden-trained hold-up horse returning from a 209-day absence; has fair Goodwood form and Good-ground figures (1W3P on similar going), but the layoff is significant and blinkered runners fresh off such breaks can be unpredictable in a big field.

runners_data.name: Midak
runners_data.note: Hold-up type for Ian Williams last ran just 10 days ago which shows he is race-fit; has struggled to convert decent efforts into wins recently (four consecutive defeats) and his form profile at 10-12f on Good is workmanlike rather than exciting.

runners_data.name: Yabher
runners_data.note: William Haggas's hold-up horse has outstanding Good-ground form (4W in 5 Goodwood starts on Good) and boasts an impressive 101-10 recent form string; Tom Marquand takes the ride and this is firmly the most potent late-running profile in the field.

runners_data.name: Henlein
runners_data.note: Suited by a strongly-run race given his hold-up style but recent form reads poorly — 22nd, 7th, 15th last three — and dropping back to 10f after those modest outings at shorter suggests connections are searching for answers.

runners_data.name: Diego El Queso
runners_data.note: Colin Keane's mount has placed in both recent Goodwood runs on Good ground, posting 2nd and 1st; genuine prominent type who should slot comfortably just behind Liberty Lane and his recent consistency (83-212) makes him a natural beneficiary of a steady pace.

runners_data.name: Wave Rider
runners_data.note: Oisin Murphy partners this George Scott horse returning from 129 days off; prominent runner with very strong Good-ground form (1W4P in 5 Goodwood 10f starts) and if race-sharp after the break, trips easily into the sweet spot just off the pace.

runners_data.name: Quai De Bethune
runners_data.note: James Doyle rides a horse who won over this course and distance last season on Good ground; has since struggled (13th, 6th in two Goodwood returns) and a 0-trainer-last-14 flag adds doubt, but the course-and-distance win is a live reference.

runners_data.name: Night Breeze
runners_data.note: In tremendous form (034123 recent string) and has won over 12f at Goodwood on Good ground; tongue-tied, Ian Williams yard in decent nick (T14: 3/24), and as a prominent type who should get a clear run, the 12f trip suits this stamina-laden profile well.

runners_data.name: King's Code
runners_data.note: Won over 10f at Goodwood on Good last time and the visor is worn again; David Evans's horse has a patchy record at longer trips (5th, 10th, 14th at 12f) so whether the extra furlong here is a concern is real, despite the course win boosting his claims.

runners_data.name: Dhahabi
runners_data.note: An 8-year-old true hold-up type for Ian Williams who is genuinely mapped to midfield only because the hold-up berths are oversubscribed; 53 days off and a recent run of 0s in his form string make it difficult to fancy him, even acknowledging two historic Goodwood wins on Good.

runners_data.name: Rathgar
runners_data.note: A natural prominent racer whose last three Goodwood runs on Good produced 3rd, 1st, 1st — his course record is exceptional; the redistribution note is context rather than a killer, and if he can re-secure a forward position he is the most dangerous horse from a form standpoint.

runners_data.name: Noble Horizon
runners_data.note: De Sousa takes over on a horse who won at Goodwood on Good last time; a true front-runner type displaced to midfield on the map due to the crowded prominent positions, and if he fails to push forward early his best form may be compromised.

runners_data.name: Tony Montana
runners_data.note: Has strong Goodwood form on Good (2W across 15 starts, 6 placings) and is a prominent runner who should aim to sit just behind Liberty Lane; recent form is poor (920-68) but the course familiarity and Good ground give a small each-way case at a big price.

runners_data.name: Al Aali
runners_data.note: William Buick is a major booking for this George Scott hold-up horse who won over Goodwood 10f on Good last season; like Dhahabi, mapped to midfield rather than his natural rear position, and if Buick can thread him through from deep the stable pair (with Wave Rider) merit respect.

runners_data.name: Parole d'Oro
runners_data.note: A genuinely prominent horse whose last five runs are all on Good Goodwood turf (11/11 sim-going runs); has placed twice at the course and the tongue plate/hood combination suggests quirks, but the tight style-fit concern is real if he cannot recover his natural position.

runners_data.name: Twisting Physics
runners_data.note: Won twice on Good at Goodwood over 7-10f and gets an apprentice claimer (Ashley Lewis, 5lb) which is useful in a 18-runner handicap; displaced prominent type whose best Goodwood form suggests he handles the track well, though getting shuffled back in a big field risks his chance.

races.paceDynamic: Liberty Lane is the sole confirmed front-runner in an 18-runner field and, crucially, faces no genuine challenger for the lead — she should settle into a controlled, sustainable gallop from the front on Good ground over Goodwood's 1m2f trip. Behind her, a cluster of genuine prominent types including Diego El Queso, Wave Rider, Quai De Bethune, Night Breeze, King's Code and Tony Montana will compete hard for the handful of prominent positions, creating a scrappy, pressured early battle for the rail and a good view. Rathgar, Noble Horizon, Parole d'Oro and Twisting Physics are true prominent horses redistributed into midfield on the map — they cannot all get their natural position, and those who fail to slot in behind Liberty Lane early will be forced to race in traffic or wider than ideal. With a single unhurried pace-setter dictating a fair-but-not-fast tempo, this race shape most favours horses who can travel smoothly in the first half-dozen positions and produce a sustained finishing effort rather than a sharp late burst — patient prominent-to-midfield types with proven Goodwood form on Good ground hold the clearest tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Liberty Lane Controls, Prominent Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Liberty Lane dictates an uncontested, measured pace and the race is decided by those who travel just behind her from early.
scenarios.body: Liberty Lane sets a comfortable rhythm that keeps closers bottled up in traffic, and the horse immediately on her tail who travels smoothly into the straight gets first run and enough momentum to hold on.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If Liberty Lane's pace proves too slow and the field races in a tight bunch, leaving genuine hold-up horses room to swoop late.
scenarios.body: A compressed, slowly-run race results in a sprint finish off the home turn, and horses tucked in the rear half with a strong turn of foot get a clean run to cut through.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent War Quickens Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If several of the redistributed prominent types push up aggressively early, lifting the pace beyond Liberty Lane's comfort zone and stringing out the field.
scenarios.body: The elevated tempo burns off the pretenders mid-race and rewards the horse with the best cruising speed and stamina to grind over the Goodwood undulations; a staying-prominent profile lands it.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos, Each-Way Lurker
scenarios.trigger: If the large 18-runner field bunches critically on the home turn, causing interference that blocks the fancied runners and lets a fresh latecomer through.
scenarios.body: A wall of horses navigating the turn leaves gaps for a horse with a light weight, race-fresh legs and a good draw to dart through late; long-odds types ignored by the market creep into frame.

watchPoints.text: Yabher (Haggas/Marquand) has won four of five starts at Goodwood on Good ground — if the pace is steady and he gets a clean run from the hold-up position, his turn of foot is the biggest single threat to any prominent horse.

Rathgar has won twice and placed once from his last three Goodwood starts on Good and is a natural prominent type — watch whether David Probert can push him forward early to reclaim his preferred position, because if he does, his course form is the most dangerous in the race.

Wave Rider returns from 129 days off for George Scott and Oisin Murphy — fit horses from this yard have performed fresh before, but in a race of 18 where position matters, watch for him being caught wide or short of room after the long break.

Night Breeze carries the tongue-tie and is in excellent form (three wins or places from last four) — if Liberty Lane's pace is genuinely slow and Night Breeze can track her from a prominent position, the staying profile at 12f on Good Goodwood is a live threat.

With five redistributed prominent types (Rathgar, Noble Horizon, Parole d'Oro, Twisting Physics, and Liberty Lane herself pushed forward) plus six natural prominent runners, the opening half-mile is likely to see fierce jostling for position — watch for horses drawn wide being knocked off stride and losing ground before the race has truly begun.

races.name: Coral Vintage Stakes (Group 2)

runners_data.name: Al Hudaiba
runners_data.note: Charlie Appleby's unbeaten filly (3 wins from 4 at Goodwood, all on Good) wears a hood and arrives 17 days fresh; her natural prominent style suits this race shape perfectly and William Buick's course craft makes her one of the best-positioned horses in the field tactically.

runners_data.name: Dr Rascal
runners_data.note: Oliver Cole's unbeaten colt (2 wins, both at Goodwood on Good) is a genuine front-runner who will press for the lead from the off; T14 form reads just 1/11 suggesting the yard is not firing at peak, which is a mild but noted flag at Group 2 level.

runners_data.name: Haffner
runners_data.note: Ryan Moore partners the highest-rated runner in the field for Aidan O'Brien, and Haffner's front-running profile on 2/2 Good ground at Goodwood makes him the controlling force in this race; his Goodwood record (winning his last run here) and Group class make him a serious pace-shape factor whatever happens early.

runners_data.name: Pikachu
runners_data.note: Charlie Johnston's colt has placed twice at Goodwood over 7f Good but has not won here, and his natural prominent style is crowded out by the deeper pace bias in this field — fielded in effect as a midfield runner, he needs the pace to collapse for his finishing effort to fully materialise, which tempers his chance.

runners_data.name: Ruler's Control
runners_data.note: Joseph Patrick O'Brien's colt steps up from a 5f Hea win and stretches to a first run on Good turf at Goodwood; the 41-day break, a tongue tie, and a concern about the Good ground being his first true encounter at this course-going combination add uncertainty, but his natural prominent style fits this scenario well if he handles the step up in trip.

runners_data.name: Undiscovered
runners_data.note: Ralph Beckett's 2-from-2 filly won on Soft at 6f and Good at 7f Goodwood, showing versatility, but in this field she is pushed to the rear of the tactical map despite being a genuinely prominent-minded sort — her best chance comes if the race develops slowly and she can slot into her preferred tracking role rather than being squeezed wide.

races.paceDynamic: Haffner and Dr Rascal are both confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead from the gates, creating a genuinely competitive pace for a six-runner Group 2 over Goodwood's 7f. Ryan Moore on Haffner is likely to dictate terms given Haffner's superior OR and Aidan O'Brien's tactical awareness, but Kaiya Fraser on Dr Rascal will push for a share, meaning the gallop will be honest rather than suicidal — enough to stretch the field but not enough to gift it to closers. Al Hudaiba and Ruler's Control, both prominent types with the class to travel efficiently just off the pace, are the profile that benefits most from this shape: they can conserve energy in the slipstream of a genuine two-horse battle and unleash a finish on ground confirmed Good throughout. The field holds more front-running and prominent types than can all secure their preferred position — Pikachu and Undiscovered are natural prominent/midfield horses respectively who are displaced in the race map, with Al Hudaiba and Ruler's Control far better placed to actually hold their racing positions and capitalise.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Lead, Prominent Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Haffner and Dr Rascal fight for the front and set an honest but sustainable gallop, allowing a prominent tracker to pounce.
scenarios.body: Haffner and Dr Rascal burn each other up through a genuine pace while Al Hudaiba and Ruler's Control track within two lengths, then produce their finishing kicks entering the Goodwood straight. This scenario rewards horses who can race prominently in an economy zone and quicken once the pacemakers tie each other up; both Al Hudaiba and Ruler's Control are perfectly built for it.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Haffner Dictates Unopposed
scenarios.trigger: If Dr Rascal fails to press Haffner's early tempo, allowing Moore to control the pace and conserve enough to quicken clear.
scenarios.body: With a soft lead Haffner sets a measured gallop that plays to his own strengths, arriving at the 2f marker full of running and using his class to extend away from the field. A dominant front-runner dictating his own terms at Goodwood over 7f Good ground is a formidable proposition, and Moore would be expected to capitalise on any lack of pressure with a perfectly judged front-running ride.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Implodes, Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the two front-runners push too hard and both capitulate in the straight, leaving it open to a horse coming through late.
scenarios.body: A strong early duel between Haffner and Dr Rascal leaves both emptying inside the final furlong, creating a gap for anything with residual energy to motor through the wreckage. Pikachu, despite being redistributed from its preferred position, still carries enough ability on Good Goodwood ground to make up ground if the pace truly falls apart, though its displaced map position reduces the likelihood of this scenario delivering.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Muddle, No True Pace
scenarios.trigger: If neither Haffner nor Dr Rascal commit to the front and the race is run at a falsely slow tempo that turns it into a sprint.
scenarios.body: A crawl would compress the field and make it a raw sprint from 2f out, neutralising the tactical advantage of the prominent trackers and rewarding whoever can quicken most sharply from a slow early pace. Undiscovered, a natural prominent type shown at rear in the map, is unlikely to benefit from this shape given its displaced position, but Ruler's Control's gate-to-wire 5f Hea win hints at raw speed that could fire in a stolen-sprint finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch whether Dr Rascal genuinely contests Haffner for the lead in the first furlong — if Kaiya Fraser commits fully, Moore may be forced to overdrive Haffner early, fundamentally altering the pace shape and shortening both front-runners' winning chances.

Ruler's Control is stepping onto Good Goodwood turf for the first time after winning on Heathstown; if he moves with any reluctance or fails to stride out fluently in the first 2f, his chance of tracking in his optimal prominent position is compromised.

Pikachu is a natural prominent horse mapped to midfield due to pace congestion — watch the first 2f to see whether David Egan attempts to push forward to reclaim a tracking position or accepts the rear-of-midfield slot, as it will determine whether he is in the race at all entering the straight.

Al Hudaiba runs in a hood (blinkers type not specified) — any sign of greenness or reluctance to settle behind the two front-runners in the early stages would be the key visual cue against her, given her chance depends entirely on a clean prominent run and a clear passage from 2f out.

The Good ground is confirmed uniform across all Goodwood races today with no variation reported; no going concern applies to any runner, meaning the race will be decided by tactics and class rather than ground adaptability.

races.name: Hkjc World Pool Lennox Stakes (Group 2)

runners_data.name: Holguin
runners_data.note: Six-year-old with a strong course record at Goodwood including a win over this exact 7f trip, trained by Hamad Al Jehani who has had a quiet 14-day strike rate; by nature a prominent racer, he will find it difficult to secure his favoured position with so many similar types in this field and James Doyle may have to improvise tactically.

runners_data.name: Lake Forest
runners_data.note: William Haggas has this five-year-old in excellent hands and the horse boasts a formidable record at Goodwood with 13 runs on similar going; as the sole confirmed pace-setter he holds a unique positional advantage, and Cieren Fallon will look to leverage an uncontested lead, though his last run over 8f at Haydock was below-par form.

runners_data.name: Marvelman
runners_data.note: Andrew Balding's four-year-old has a solid Goodwood profile and won over 7f on soft ground, suggesting the distance and likely conditions suit well; PJ McDonald will want to sit close to the leader in genuine prominent territory and a clean run from that position makes him well-placed in the dominant race shape.

runners_data.name: Poet Master
runners_data.note: K.R. Burke sends this six-year-old in on the back of consistent placed efforts over 7f, and Clifford Lee has the tactical nous to navigate a crowded prominent group; at heart a front-rank type, he is likely to find the position he wants is already taken by Lake Forest and several equally-minded rivals, tempering expectations.

runners_data.name: Qirat
runners_data.note: Ralph Beckett's five-year-old won over this exact 7f at Goodwood on Good ground last time, which is an obvious plus, and Colin Keane is an experienced big-race jockey; however, he wears a hood and most of his recent form has come over 8f in softer conditions, while his prominent tendencies may go unrealised in a field this congested ahead of him.

runners_data.name: Rogue Diplomat
runners_data.note: James Owen's four-year-old has won twice including over 7f on soft, and Harry Davies has been riding with confidence; a front-rank operator by inclination, he steps back in trip from recent 8f runs and will need to find a rhythm from a position further back than he would naturally like given the prominent traffic ahead.

runners_data.name: Witness Stand
runners_data.note: Wears a tongue-tie and has placed twice over 7f on soft ground, suggesting soft or easing conditions would suit ideally, though Good ground is not a disqualifying factor; Kieran Shoemark can be positive, and if he can get Witness Stand into one of the prominent slots that actually materialises, his course experience is a genuine asset.

runners_data.name: Lord Britain
runners_data.note: The sole hold-up horse in the field and the youngest runner at age three, carrying a 7lb pull in the weights versus his elders via the 125lb allotment; his form at Goodwood over shorter trips has been modest and he holds no winning form on the going, but he is the only runner genuinely able to come from off the pace if the front does collapse.

races.paceDynamic: Lake Forest is the one confirmed front-runner and will stride into the lead from the outset, setting a sustainable rather than frenetic gallop over Goodwood's 7f on Good ground. With no genuine rival willing or able to seriously contest that lead — Holguin, Qirat, Poet Master and Rogue Diplomat are all natural prominent types but this field is overloaded with such horses, meaning most will have to settle for cover rather than their preferred berth — Lake Forest will control tempo and dictate the fractions unchallenged. The oversubscribed prominent group creates a congested midpack where several horses will race out of role, likely producing a muddled contest behind the leader rather than a clean, rhythm-building pursuit. This shape strongly favours horses who can sit closest to Lake Forest in genuine prominent position — specifically Marvelman and Witness Stand, who have the profile to occupy those slots — or a horse with enough class and turn of foot to pick off a front-runner who has had an uncontested lead, rather than true closers who must make up ground from deep.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lake Forest Dictates Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Lake Forest is allowed to bowl along in front at a controlled pace and the overcrowded prominent group cancels itself out behind.
scenarios.body: Lake Forest sets fractions to suit himself without being harassed, conserving energy through the middle section before kicking clear in the final two furlongs; horses trapped in the congested midpack struggle to find clear passage or generate momentum until it is too late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Pounces Late
scenarios.trigger: If Lake Forest's uncontested lead tempts him to coast, leaving him vulnerable to a prominent-tracking horse who sits second or third and swoops in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: A horse locked onto Lake Forest's quarters throughout gets a tow into contention and finds extra when shaken up, catching a front-runner who was allowed to over-relax midrace; the key is getting one of the prominent types into that ideal tracking slot.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Lake Forest's uncontested lead proves illusory and he weakens sharply in the final furlong, leaving the race open for a hold-up horse or a late-finishing prominent type.
scenarios.body: Lord Britain, racing from the rear as the only genuine hold-up type, would benefit from the field coming back to him, though his form suggests he is some way short of this level on raw ratings; any prominent runner who found trouble and had to be switched could also find late daylight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Contested Pace, Attrition Finish
scenarios.trigger: If two or more of the redistributed prominent types push forward aggressively from the outset and create a genuine early pace battle with Lake Forest.
scenarios.body: A faster-than-expected gallop tests the stamina of the entire field and turns the race into a battle of endurance over the final two furlongs; horses with proven ability to handle a strong pace and finish resolutely would profit, though this scenario requires several jockeys to abandon their planned tactical rides.

watchPoints.text: Lake Forest's uncontested lead is the defining factor — watch whether any jockey breaks ranks from the prominent group to apply early pressure, as any challenge to his supremacy in the first three furlongs changes the entire race shape.

The congested prominent group containing Holguin, Qirat, Poet Master and Rogue Diplomat creates significant risk of interference and cover-seeking in the early stages — horses trapped three or four wide with no run as they enter the straight could find their races effectively over.

Marvelman's ability to secure an unobstructed second or third position directly behind Lake Forest is crucial to his chance in the dominant scenario; if he is baulked or pushed wider than ideal by the prominent logjam, his finishing effort will be compromised.

Lord Britain's 7lb weight advantage over the older horses is worth noting as a raw factor, but his lack of similar-going Goodwood form and hold-up style mean he requires a very specific race to unfold — monitor market moves for any late support that might signal stable confidence beyond what the form book suggests.

Witness Stand's tongue-tie and previous placed form over this course and distance make him a sleeper in the prominent slots if the field sorts itself out — watch his early position under Shoemark as a guide to whether he secures a genuine racing berth or gets shuffled back.

races.name: Al Shaqab Goodwood Cup Stakes (Group 1)

runners_data.name: Amiloc
runners_data.note: Ralph Beckett's four-year-old has progressive form at Goodwood including a win over 12f here, but naturally races prominently and is compressed into a midfield slot by the surplus of front-facing horses in this field; the STYLE_FIT tag tempers confidence that he can reproduce his best from an unnatural position.|

runners_data.name: French Master
runners_data.note: John & Thady Gosden's five-year-old showed a career-best when second in the Goodwood Cup last year over this exact course and distance, wears a hood, and his 9/11 good-ground record is strong, but he is a natural forward-going type squeezed out of his preferred position by the pace dynamic here.|

runners_data.name: Illinois
runners_data.note: Won this race last year over 2m at Goodwood and comes in fresh off a nine-day turnaround; A P O'Brien's five-year-old is a front-facing type by nature but that instinct is suppressed by the loaded pace here, and Sean Levey will have to manage a position that doesn't come naturally to him.|

runners_data.name: Lazy Griff
runners_data.note: Charlie Johnston's lightly-used four-year-old is on a hat-trick and has placed in all five career starts, giving Oisin Murphy a horse with abundant Goodwood experience over 12-16f; genuine prominent racer by preference, but his adaptability and recent win over 16f here suggest he can find a forward position if he needs to.|

runners_data.name: Rahiebb
runners_data.note: Roger Varian's four-year-old has the best recent form of those outside Scandinavia and Trawlerman — winning over 14f and placed over 14f on soft and good — and has scope from his OR-116 mark; his Goodwood Cup run (8th over 20f) is the one blemish, though 20f may have been beyond him at the time.|

runners_data.name: Scandinavia
runners_data.note: Ryan Moore aboard an unbeaten five-from-five stayer with six wins from 10 career starts on going identical or similar to today's; A P O'Brien's four-year-old won this race last year, has a 6W from those Goodwood visits, and the combination of course form, jockey pedigree and positional ease in a front-two scenario makes her the standout profile fit.|

runners_data.name: Trawlerman
runners_data.note: William Buick's eight-year-old veteran is the only confirmed front-runner in the race and has won four of his last five over this track and distance including back-to-back Goodwood Cup wins; his STYLE_FIT flag reflects that his hold-up headgear history suggests occasional tactical variation, but the pace data places him unambiguously in the lead role here.|

runners_data.name: Miss Alpilles
runners_data.note: Ed Walker's five-year-old is a genuine hold-up horse — not a displaced prominent type — who has placed in four of her last five and won twice over 14-16f on good ground; Kieran Shoemark will drop her out and she is the most authentic closer in the field, but she needs the pace to collapse for her late run to reach the principals in time.|

races.paceDynamic: Trawlerman is the sole confirmed front-runner and, with William Buick in the saddle, will stride to the front and control this at a sustainable, unhurried gallop over Goodwood's two-mile trip on Good ground. The field is loaded with prominent-style horses — Amiloc, Lazy Griff, Illinois, French Master and Scandinavia all want to race close to the pace — but only one or two can genuinely track Trawlerman from the front, and the rest will be shuffled into a midfield they don't naturally inhabit. Scandinavia, with her unbeaten record and strong Goodwood form, is the most likely to lock onto Trawlerman's quarters given Ryan Moore's positional intelligence, with Rahiebb and Lazy Griff the next most probable to find a forward berth. With the pace controlled and modest, this race shape strongly favours a classy horse who can sit within a length or two of the lead and kick from the front — a profile that disadvantages genuine hold-up horses and benefits those with a clean line to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Trawlerman Controls, Scandinavia Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Trawlerman dictates a measured gallop and Scandinavia tracks him throughout before asserting her superior finishing form.
scenarios.body: Buick sets fractions that suit the leader and the race develops into a procession until the final quarter-mile, where Scandinavia's unbeaten five-race winning streak and outstanding Goodwood record give her the pace reserves to go by. Horses redistributed into false midfield positions will lack the momentum to mount a clean challenge from off the bridle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Modest Gallop, Front Two Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Trawlerman and one tracker steal a decisive break when the hold-up horses fail to respond from unnatural positions.
scenarios.body: Trawlerman kicks at the two-furlong pole and none of the prominent types, racing out of their natural rhythm in midfield, can bridge the gap quickly enough. Trawlerman reverses recent Ascot form with Scandinavia if the pace disadvantages anything that needs covering ground late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Late Rush
scenarios.trigger: If Trawlerman is harried more than expected and sets a pace that burns horses out, opening the race for a late finisher.
scenarios.body: Miss Alpilles, a genuine hold-up horse who is not misrepresented in her mapped position, would be the primary beneficiary as the field comes back to her in the closing stages. Illinois, who won this race last year over the course and distance, also has the finishing profile to pick up late ground from a similar position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Types Dominate Midfield Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If several prominent horses contest middle positions and the resulting internal competition produces an unusually strung-out race that rewards a horse who threads through late.
scenarios.body: This shape is the least likely because the horses who would win it are predominantly reassigned prominent types racing against their instincts, making a coordinated late surge improbable. French Master or Amiloc represent the best chance in this unlikely scenario given their class and previous Goodwood experience.

watchPoints.text: Scandinavia's jumping position at the start bears watching — if Ryan Moore elects to go straight to Trawlerman's shoulder from the outset rather than settling mid-division, the race could be effectively over before halfway, as no horse in this field has the profile to go with both of them.|

Trawlerman's gallop fractions in the first mile are critical — if Buick is allowed to dictate a true stayers' crawl below 2:30 sectionals to the mile mark, the entire field will be coiled for a sprint finish that may suit Scandinavia more than the leader himself.|

Lazy Griff and Amiloc both want the same prominent position behind the leader; if they compete with each other for that slot in the early stages, both could burn energy that compromises their finishing effort in the final quarter-mile.|

Miss Alpilles is the only runner whose mapped position reflects her genuine tactical preference — watch whether Ed Walker and Shoemark allow her to settle last or near-last, which would be the truest signal she is being placed to produce her best closing effort rather than being covered up by the pace dynamic.|

Illinois won this race 12 months ago and A P O'Brien's runners at Goodwood carry a strong record; his stable's 5/46 14-day strike rate is modest, but Sean Levey's awareness of the pace shape — and whether he elects to use Illinois's natural forward inclination — will determine whether last year's winning run can be replicated from a compromised position.|

races.name: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Jasour
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who has five recent starts at Goodwood over 6f (OR 104 today back to 5f); drop to this minimum trip at a track where he has placed once in 13 similar-going runs is a concern, and PJ McDonald needs a strong pace to make the most of his late run.

runners_data.name: Run Boy Run
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner and the sole pace-maker in the race; has won twice at Goodwood over 5f and posted a 2nd here too, making his course form compelling — he's racing out of his deepest role and his chance hinges entirely on getting the lead uncontested.

runners_data.name: Lexington Blitz
runners_data.note: Prominent-style 5f specialist with two wins at Goodwood at the course and three wins on Good ground — 52-day absence is the only question mark, but Robert Cowell horses run well fresh and Edward Greatrex knows the track well.

runners_data.name: Candy
runners_data.note: Prominent type whose lone win came over 6f on Soft, and both Goodwood runs have produced double-figure finishes; Richard Spencer yard in fair form but this course-going profile (8/15 similar runs) is the weakest among the prominent group.

runners_data.name: Democracy Dilemma
runners_data.note: Hold-up sprinter with two wins on similar going but only 9/15 in comparable conditions; the 52-day absence mirrors stablemate Lexington Blitz, and Cowell's record with this horse is patchy — finished 20th at this course over 5f on Soft last time.

runners_data.name: Toca Madera
runners_data.note: A genuine Goodwood 5f performer with 15-from-15 course-going matches and one win plus five places here — Daniel Tudhope's booking is a significant positive, and his racing from a prominent position in a large field suits the expected race shape.

runners_data.name: Adrestia
runners_data.note: Naturally prominent and consistent at Goodwood over 5f, with 14/15 course-going matches and placed form; Oisin Murphy is a top-class booking and the horse's OR of 94 looks workable off a 17-day break in which the yard has maintained decent form.

runners_data.name: Germanic
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose three wins have come at Southwell or Carlisle and whose Goodwood and similar-going credentials are thin (3/15 matched runs); 185-day absence and unfamiliar conditions make this the most vulnerable of the prominent group despite a competitive OR.

runners_data.name: Regal Envoy
runners_data.note: A 7-year-old prominent type with three wins over 5f and two at Goodwood; 11/15 course-going matches and Taylor Fisher's booking in a big-field sprint is a minor negative, but the horse's consistency at this track and trip is a tangible asset.

runners_data.name: Naana's Sparkle
runners_data.note: Won last time at Southwell over 5f and placed four times at Goodwood; hg:t (tongue tie) suggests a breathing aid is helping, and this lightly raced 4-year-old's course form and OR of 92 make her one of the more interesting prominent types at the weights.

runners_data.name: The Man

runners_data.name: Twilight Calls

runners_data.name: Desert Cop

runners_data.name: Exclamation

runners_data.name: Glamorous Breeze

runners_data.name: Rapper's Delight

runners_data.name: Ziggy's Triton

runners_data.name: Tatterstall
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with three wins and six places in 15 course-going runs — consistent course form at Goodwood, and Connor Beasley rides well here; form string of 00-325 shows a return to form and a prominent draw could help, but a true hold-up runner relies on pace.

runners_data.name: Seven Questions
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with one Goodwood 5f win and 9/15 similar-going form; Jamie Spencer is a masterful tactician in big fields and Seven Questions can get back and come late, though the form string of 364170 includes a 0 last time out which warrants caution.

runners_data.name: Dyonisos
runners_data.note: Won at Goodwood over 5f and placed twice in 9/15 similar-going runs — a naturally prominent horse displaced to midfield by the overcrowded pace map; his STYLE_FIT discount is real, and Cieren Fallon will face an early decision about whether to push forward or accept the deeper slot.

runners_data.name: Vintage Clarets

runners_data.name: Spring Is Sprung
runners_data.note: Front-running inclination but finds himself among the displaced prominent group; four recent top-4 finishes at Goodwood over 5f show real course aptitude, and Paul Midgley's 7-year-old could outrun his OR of 85 if he secures a forward position — which is the central question.

runners_data.name: Wheels Of Fire
runners_data.note: A natural hold-up horse mapped to midfield by the sheer volume of deep runners — his OR of 83 is the second-lowest in the field, a 57-day absence is notable, and his Goodwood 5f form shows a 7th last time here; Silvestre De Sousa provides class in the saddle but the weights stack against him.

runners_data.name: Reigning Profit
runners_data.note: Hold-up type redistributed to midfield — his entire form book has been run at Goodwood over 5f (9/15 similar-going), and two wins at the track show genuine course affinity; hg:b (blinkers) plus a sharp 11-day turnaround from Andrew Mullen and Ruth Carr suggests connections see him in good form.

races.paceDynamic: Run Boy Run is the one confirmed front-runner here and, with a clear lead in a field of 24, is expected to bowl along at a sustainable but honest pace on Good ground over Goodwood's straight five furlongs — enough to set a tempo that tests the field without inviting a suicidal gallop. The critical complication is the sheer volume of naturally prominent types: Lexington Blitz, Toca Madera, Adrestia, Regal Envoy, Naana's Sparkle, Ziggy's Triton, Germanic, and Candy all want to race up with the pace, and they cannot all do so in a 24-runner sprint, meaning several will be squeezed into a midfield slot against their instincts. Rapper's Delight, Glamorous Breeze, Dyonisos, and Spring Is Sprung are genuine prominent types redistributed to midfield because the prominent berths are already oversubscribed — those who actually secure a front-rank position (most likely Lexington Blitz, Toca Madera, and Adrestia based on course form and draw logistics) will be best placed. The race shape — honest but not scorching pace, crowded early, strung out across a wide field — favours horses that can race prominently without fighting for position and carry their speed all the way to the line, giving a clear edge to the front-to-prominent profile over hold-up closers who will find traffic and the short five furlongs insufficiently testing to bridge the gap.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Types Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Run Boy Run leads at a fair clip and the genuinely prominent horses secure their natural position from the off, setting up a race where those close to the pace have first run.
scenarios.body: Run Boy Run sets a true pace that strings the field out early, and the horses positioned just behind in the first two or three lengths carry their speed home on Good ground without needing a change of gear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Run Boy Run is allowed to stride clear uncontested and the prominent types interfere with each other in the first furlong, leaving the leader with a decisive break.
scenarios.body: With a clear lead and no immediate challenger, Run Boy Run dictates every yard and the field fails to close on Good ground that doesn't inconvenience him; his Goodwood course form of 1-2 at the track supports the hold.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is stronger than anticipated due to prominent runners battling for position in the early stages, burning off the leaders and opening the race up for hold-up horses with finishing power.
scenarios.body: A contested early scramble for position elevates the tempo and leaves front-rank horses vulnerable inside the final furlong, allowing genuine hold-up horses to come through; Twilight Calls, who has won twice at Goodwood over five furlongs, and Desert Cop, with 15-from-15 course-going form, are best suited to capitalise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Surge Wins
scenarios.trigger: If traffic and positional chaos in a 24-runner field causes widespread trouble, with a mid-division runner finding a clear passage late.
scenarios.body: The wide draw and large field create pockets of interference that neutralise horses at both extremes, and a horse travelling well in midfield who finds an unimpeded run can pick up the pieces; redistributed types like Dyonisos or Rapper's Delight — both naturally prominent but racing from deeper — are the most plausible beneficiaries if they get clear.

watchPoints.text: Run Boy Run is the key pace influence — if he gets uncontested to the front in the first two strides, the race shape is set and those prominently placed behind him have first call; watch his early position from the stalls.

runners_data.name: Nanino Niyati

races.paceDynamic: Wid is the sole confirmed front-runner and, with only one horse wanting to lead, Edward Greatrex can dictate a sustainable, uncontested gallop from the front — this is not a race that will be run at a frenetic pace. Behind Wid, a congested prominent group of six — Just Call Me Angel, Rumba Numba, Song N Dance, Annastarzy, Star Mirage and Si Grass — will jostle for the four or five positions immediately behind the leader, creating compression and potential traffic issues rounding the home turn and two to three furlongs out. The field holds more front-running and prominent types than can all secure their natural position: Vixey, Crazee Icon, Proposal and Perdy In Paris are genuine prominent racers who will be squeezed back into a midfield role against their instincts, adding to the early scrimmage. With one honest pace-setter and a Good surface on the Goodwood mile, this shape favours horses who can race prominently in the first four or five — particularly those with tactical speed to sit just off Wid — rather than deep closers who will face traffic, because the even gallop is unlikely to stretch the field enough to create daylight for late runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Wid Controls, Prominent Win
scenarios.trigger: If Wid sets a fair, uncontested pace and the horse closest to the action at two furlongs out has the class to hold on.
scenarios.body: Greatrex allows Wid to roll along unchallenged, setting a rhythm that suits those tracking in second or third; the lack of a true pace battle means energy is conserved and the winner will come from the prominent group rather than behind. Annastarzy, Just Call Me Angel and Rumba Numba are ideally positioned to pounce off a genuine but measured gallop and their recent Goodwood form gives them the track advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Wid Flatters, Hold-Up Swamps
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is so modest that it compresses the field and late movers come from off the pace in a bunch finish.
scenarios.body: A slow to moderate gallop bunches the entire field approaching the final two furlongs, neutralising positional advantage and giving hold-up horses a clear run through; Betty Clover, Nanino Niyati and Electrifarhh can all deliver a sustained late challenge if the field opens up. Nanino Niyati's strong Goodwood record and Betty Clover's front-running course profile both suit if they find clear daylight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Scrum Frees Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the six-horse prominent battle becomes rough enough between two and three furlongs out that closers bypass the carnage.
scenarios.body: The inevitable pushing and crowding among the prominent group — including the redistributed Crazee Icon, Proposal and Perdy In Paris racing out of role — causes hesitation and checks mid-race, letting a horse from midfield arrive without interference. Crazee Icon's recent winning form is solid but its true prominent style means it will have been squeezed back, and any smooth passage through could be rewarding.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wid Outstays All
scenarios.trigger: If the field over-commits chasing Wid and Greatrex times the fractions perfectly to score on the front end.
scenarios.body: Wid's last two runs at Goodwood — a win and a second over this exact course and distance — show it handles this test well, and if the pace-chasing prominent horses burn out at the two-furlong pole Wid simply holds them at bay. This scenario is minority probability given the weight of opposition, but the horse's track-specific record cannot be dismissed.

watchPoints.text: Prominent traffic danger 2-3 furlongs out — six horses (Just Call Me Angel, Rumba Numba, Song N Dance, Annastarzy, Star Mirage, Si Grass) are all seeking the same positions, creating a high risk of checking or crowding on the home turn.

Vixey, Crazee Icon, Proposal and Perdy In Paris are all natural prominent types who will be squeezed into midfield roles — watch for any of them pulling hard or forcing their way forward in the early stages, which could unsettle the pack order.

Star Mirage (221-day absence) and Si Grass (167-day absence) are two lightly-raced three-year-olds returning from extended breaks — if either shows signs of ring-rustiness or bolts into the prominent group, it could disrupt the early order around Wid.

Wid's pace control is the key variable — if Greatrex is pressured into going faster than ideal by the prominent group, the race opens up significantly for hold-up horses like Nanino Niyati and Betty Clover; watch the early fractions closely.

Annastarzy's three-race winning streak is the form hotspot, but all three wins came at this track — if the pace is truly genuine and she gets her customary prominent position, her Goodwood record becomes highly relevant from the two-furlong pole.

races.paceDynamic: Cinque Verde is the confirmed front-runner here and, in a field where so many runners carry prominent profiles, she is likely to secure a clear lead early with little genuine pressure from a dedicated rival. The pack behind her is densely populated with natural pace-holers — Gold Digger, Machadadorp, Hold A Dream, Stormy Impact, Cindy Lou Who, Sing The Blues and Ruby's Angel all want to race prominently, yet only a handful can physically sit up with the early pace in a 21-runner field. Runners tagged redistributed — Fleetwater, Secret History, Zighy, Zen Diva, Paradise Walk, Bintaryana, Diamont Katie, Polka Blue and Woohoo — are all true prominent racers who will be shuffled back against their nature, meaning they will race uncomfortably off the pace and are unlikely to reproduce their best form. On Good ground over 6f at Goodwood with a solo leader setting a steady, controlled tempo, the race is set to be dominated by the established prominent closers travelling smoothly just off Cinque Verde's shoulder, with the true hold-up horses Beaujolais Nouveau, Shallow, Angel Shared and Rogue Attraction needing a strong late surge that a moderate pace may not generate — this race shape firmly favours horses who can sit second or third early and kick once Cinque Verde is reeled in.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent stalkers dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Cinque Verde bowls along in front at a controlled Good-ground clip and the pack of genuine prominent horses sit just behind her through the first three furlongs.
scenarios.body: Runners travelling comfortably in second to fourth position — Gold Digger, Machadadorp, Sing The Blues — are ideally poised to surge past a tiring leader in the final furlong on Goodwood's straight run-in, rewarding those who can maintain a high cruising speed without burning early energy.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader holds on wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace Cinque Verde sets is genuinely modest and she conserves enough to sustain her effort through the final furlong against a congested midfield.
scenarios.body: A steady tempo means Cinque Verde never fully empties her tank, and the wall of prominent horses reshuffled into midfield are too slow to wind up from their unnatural positions, leaving the leader alone in front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses finish late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens sharply mid-race and creates a genuine strong gallop that string the field out and leave space for late finishers.
scenarios.body: Beaujolais Nouveau and Shallow, as genuine hold-up types with strong Goodwood course form, are best placed to capitalise on a truly run race by getting a late tow into contention off fast fractions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Crowded midfield scrimmage
scenarios.trigger: If the large 21-runner field bunches into traffic trouble mid-race, causing prominent runners to lose momentum and creating a chaotic, scrimmage-style finish.
scenarios.body: Runners with course experience and the ability to find gaps — Diamont Katie and Polka Blue, both Goodwood-consistent types — may sneak a placing by threading through a fractured field, though both race uncomfortably out of their natural prominent role here.

watchPoints.text: Gold Digger's record of 5/5 wins or places on Good ground at Goodwood over 6f, combined with Saffie Osborne's booking and a trainer in form, makes her the most dangerous prominent stalk threat if she travels smoothly just off Cinque Verde's shoulder.

The sheer volume of natural prominent racers — Fleetwater, Secret History, Zighy, Zen Diva, Paradise Walk, Bintaryana, Polka Blue and Woohoo all crowding the midfield band against their nature — creates a real risk of scrimmaging and interference in the early to middle stages of a 21-runner field.

Machadadorp is stepping down from 7f to 6f for the first time; Oisin Murphy's booking suggests connections believe the trip is fine, but watch the early pace carefully to see if she can hold a prominent pitch without getting outpaced by the established sprinters.

Cinque Verde's ability to control the tempo unchallenged is the single biggest tactical variable — if anything forces her wider or breaks her stride early, the entire race shape shifts toward the hold-up horses Beaujolais Nouveau, Shallow and Rogue Attraction.
